unit.unitinstructions:
The Mechanical Turk task you have selected is part of a research project that is described below. You will use you computer for this experiment.

This project involves two sessions that take place 48 hours apart. Participants must complete both sessions in order to be fully compensated. The first session will consist of taking a pretest to assess your prior knowledge about basic research methods. Then you will complete a practice portion in which you answer additional questions as a method of studying this material. You may also be asked questions regarding your current mood or level of motivation. This first session should take about 45 to 60 minutes to complete. You will be compensated $3.50 for completing the first session.

You will be emailed (through MTurk) 48 hours after completing the first session with a link to complete the second session of this experiment. The second session should take approximately 30 minutes to complete. After completing the second session, you will be paid an additional $2.50.

If you should have any questions about this research study please feel free to contact Jaclyn Maass at jkmaass@memphis.edu. For questions regarding the research subjects' rights, the Chair of the Institutional Review Board for the Protection of Human Subjects should be contacted via phone at 901 768 2705 or via email at irb@memphis.edu.

All efforts, within the limits allowed by law, will be made to keep the personal information (your Amazon Turk Worker ID) in your research record private but total privacy cannot be promised. We will deidentify your data (remove your ID) after the experiment before storing it on our computers long-term. Because of privacy and confidentiality limitations associated with using MTurk IDs, we cannot guarantee complete anonymity. Worker IDs will only be used to distribute payment and will not be stored with survey responses. MTurk Worker IDs will not be shared with anyone. Further identifying information we gather (demographic information) will never be attached to your responses.

By participating, you understand and agree that the deidentified data gathered during this study may be used by University of Memphis and published and/or disclosed by Unviersity of Memphis to others outside of University of Memphis. However, no personally identifying information will ever be mentioned in any such publication or dissemination of the research data and/or results to other researchers.

Please click the "Continue" button if you agree to participate.

Reading all of the instructions is essential to this experiment, so please take your time to read everything on each page before moving on.
Requirements / Rules
You are NOT allowed to take notes during any portion of this experiment.
You are NOT allowed to "Google"/ search online for any of the answers. It is okay if you do not know the material well and poor performance will not affect your payment.
You MUST be a native-English speaker.

By continuing with the experiment, you are agreeing to each of the conditions listed above.

This experiment takes place over two sessions. You are about to begin the first session. The second session will begin 48 hours after this session- you will be sent a link via MTurk.

Please press continue below for more instructions.

For Part 1, you will begin by taking a brief pretest. This is meant to assess your current level of understanding about basic scientific research methods. The questions from the pretest will not be repeated later in the the experiment. It is okay if you do not know the information; do not look up any answers.

Next you will answer a set a "current emotion" questions about how you are feeling in that moment.

Third, you will complete 72 practice trials about research methods. These questions will be short answer, meaning you will type in your response. You MUST hit ENTER to submit each answer. It is important to try your best, because you will finish the experiment more quickly when you get these questions correct.

In this section you will practice different types of questions about the research methods concepts. The correct answers will be technical terms related to research and experimentation.
This section ends by asking you to answer the "current emotion" questions again. At that point, you will have completed Part 1 of the experiment. You will be given a code to enter into MTurk.

48 hours after the first session, you will receive an email with a link to complete Part 2. This session will consist of a posttest, which will assess how much you learned during Part 1.
Please make sure your internet browser window is maximized and click below to begin.

You will now begin the pretest. Please answer the each of the following 8 questions; if you do not know the answer, please make your best guess. You must begin to type your answer within 30 seconds. Remember, you must hit the Enter button to submr response. If you are unsure of an answer, please make your best guess. You will not be told if you answered correctly or incorrectly.


Click the Continue button to begin.

Please rate how much you agree with each of the following statements regarding how you are currently feeling. Each page will ask about a different emotion or state of mind, which you may or may not be feeling.

You will now begin the practice portion. This portion consists of 72 trials. You will be answering different types of questions about concepts related to scientific research methods. You will type in your answer to each question. All answers will be scientifically oriented terminology that might be used in research conducted in a psychological or medical setting.

There will be several trials for every concept, so some trials may look like previous ones you have completed.

You must begin typing your answer within 30 seconds, otherwise the system will score it as incorrect and move to the next question. You must hit the ENTER key to submit your answer.

You will receive corrective feedback for each item. This means if you get the answer correct, a "Correct" message notification will briefly appear in a green box underneath your answer. If you get the answer incorrect, you will receive a Review Period during which the correct answer will be shown in a red box at the bottom of the screen. These Review Periods last 10 seconds, which is longer than the Correct notification, so it is in your best interest to try your best to get them correct, so you can finish the experiment more quickly.

Remember that you are not allowed to take notes or "look up" any answers.

Please be sure to read each question in its entirety before answering.

Click Continue to begin the practice portion.

Please rate how much you agree with each of the following statements regarding how you are currently feeling. Each page will ask about a different emotion or state of mind, which you may or may not be feeling.
